services.name: Day Passes
services.desc: Discover flexible membership options and convenient day passes at the Apex Centre. Whether you're looking for full access to our indoor pools, state-of-the-art fitness center, or fun group classes, our memberships are designed to fit your lifestyle. Located in the heart of McKinney at Gabe Nesbitt Park, the Apex Centre offers family-friendly, affordable recreation and fitness for all ages. Youth membership registration is only available with a parent or legal guardian at the Customer Service desk. Summer Passes are non-refundable and do not require an enrollment fee or auto-renewal.
